---
title: "Browsing image collections"
---



## Browse a manifest or catalog of images

Load a IIIF manifest or a delimited-text catalog, and browse images.

![Lightbox of a collection loaded from a IIIF manifest](./imgs/lightbox.png)



## Explore an image

Pan and zoom individual images, optionally identify regions of interest.

![Focus on a single image](./imgs/single-image.png)
